verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports large-document processing. Parsing runs as asynchronous jobs, with webhooks that fire when jobs complete or fail instead of relying on long-lived requests, which mitigates client-side timeouts. The docs also mention using Cost Optimizer on long mixed-complexity documents and show batch-processing examples. Missing for 10: documented page-count and file-size limits, explicit support for thousand-page or multi-gigabyte inputs, guarantees or error signaling against silent truncation, and independent or hands-on corroboration at scale.
